name: fallen green oak sapling
description: a small, fallen, green sapling with light gray, smooth bark
details: A small sapling pushed over and lying bent across the ground, its shallow roots torn free of the soil and still trailing clods of earth.  Its bark is light gray and smooth.  The wood is still green and heavy with sap, and wilting leaves, bright yellow-green, oblong and seven-lobed, still cling to the twigs.
